title: Knowlify vs Creatify: Managed AI Ads or Self-Serve Software?
summary: Knowlify vs Creatify: finished AI ads with a person checking each one, or self-serve credits you run yourself. Compare credits, Studio pricing and Meta scope.
body_markdown:
Knowlify is our pick when you want a team to make and check AI video ads for you, with optional end-to-end Meta campaign management.[Creatify](https://creatify.ai/pricing) sells self-serve AI ad software first, with a managed Studio on top, so the real choice is whether your team will operate a tool or buy finished ads. The cost gap depends on how many generations, revisions and reviews your team absorbs.


Knowlify publishes this guide and sells one of the services compared. We used public Creatify and Knowlify pages checked in October 2026, plus Creatify's own help documentation. We did not generate ads in either tool, so this is not a quality or performance test.


## Knowlify: our top pick for finished AI ads


Knowlify fits this comparison best because the work Creatify's software leaves with you is the work Knowlify does. It delivers about 25 finished ads a week, the first batch lands on day 5, and a person checks every ad before delivery. The three formats are AI UGC (AI presenters talking to camera), 3D and stylized character animation, and AI commercials, all for Facebook and Instagram. You can take creative only if you already have a buyer, or add[end-to-end Meta management](https://knowlify.com/meta-ads-agency) .


Plans start at $5,000 a month, with the exact quote on a 30-minute call. A 90-day guarantee applies: if the ads have not made more than you paid in the first 90 days, you can cancel by email for a full refund (terms on the[pricing and guarantee](https://knowlify.com/meta-ads-agency#pricing) page). That 90-day refund applies to creative-only plans; where Knowlify runs the account, the guarantee is an agreed target in 30 days, or you don't pay for the month. When to pick another option: choose Creatify if your team wants to operate the software itself, or if you need TikTok, LinkedIn, Google or YouTube ads, which Knowlify does not run.


## How do the three routes compare?


Question Knowlify Creatify software Creatify Studio


What you receive Finished AI ads, with a person checking each one Credits you spend on generations A managed team's finished videos


Published price From $5,000 a month Standard shown at $10 to $15 a month No price on the pricing page; $100 to $200 per video in its comparison table


Volume About 25 finished ads a week 55 credits a month on Standard 25 to 100 or more videos a month


Turnaround First batch on day 5 You generate and review 48 hours listed


Who operates it Knowlify's team Your team Creatify's team


Campaign work End-to-end Meta management, or creative only Not stated for the Standard plan Not stated


## What does the self-serve route really cost?


Creatify's[pricing page](https://creatify.ai/pricing) shows the Standard plan at $15 a month with the price struck through, and $10 a month beside a "save 30% on annual plan" banner. It gives no annual total, so confirm the billing term before you pay. The 55 monthly credits buy about 11 fifteen-second avatar videos or 7 five-second Seedance 2.0 videos at 720p and 1K, and the page says higher resolution, longer clips and premium models use more credits. At 11 videos, that is about $0.91 to $1.36 a video by our arithmetic. Credits expire after two months.


The list price is only the start. The same page says manual edits to an exported project (text, captions, trims, media swaps, layout) are free and unlimited, while regenerating the video, avatar, voice or script re-runs the AI and uses credits. Creatify's[help FAQ](https://help.creatify.ai/en/articles/10468243-faqs) puts AI video ads at 5 credits per 15 seconds and revisions at 3 credits per 15 seconds. It also describes free revisions on Pro and higher, but only when the script, avatar and voice stay unchanged.


For illustration, 20 fifteen-second ads with two paid revisions each would use 20 x 5 + 40 x 3 = 220 credits by our arithmetic. That is four months of Standard allowance. Count your own labor, too: writing the script, choosing an avatar, generating takes, checking each claim and re-rendering after feedback all take staff time. A folder of generated clips is not the same as a batch of approved ads.


## What does Studio change compared with Knowlify?


Creatify's[Studio](https://creatify.ai/studio) page describes an assigned creative strategist and a team that uses AI to research your category and produce hooks, scripts and full video ads, with a human expert reviewing every deliverable. Its comparison table lists 25 to 100 or more videos a month, a 48-hour turnaround and $100 to $200 per video. The pricing page lists no Studio price and sends you to book a demo. At the table's range, 25 videos would cost $2,500 to $5,000 by our arithmetic, before any campaign work.


Two cautions apply. Another section of the Studio page mentions 100 or more videos a week, so ask which volume figure your plan would use. And the 48-hour figure is a turnaround, while Knowlify's day 5 is when the first batch lands, so the two numbers measure different things.


About 25 Knowlify ads a week is roughly 100 a month by our arithmetic, near the top of Studio's published range. Knowlify's plans start at $5,000 a month and Creatify's Studio table lists $100 to $200 per video, so ask both for a quote on the same count of accepted ads. Compare scope as well: Creatify's pages do not say whether Studio runs campaigns, while Knowlify offers Meta campaign management as an option.
